title: Custom GPUI terminal element

adjudication.reason: The Muse candidate supplied the most complete modular frame pool, damage cache, geometry, selection, cursor, palette, element, app wiring, and tests. Lead reconciliation corrected compile failures and observable rendering defects rather than combining incompatible candidate architectures.

implemented_contract: Owned pooled FrameDelta boundary with clean, partial, and full damage
GPUI-only custom Element with retained row batches and retained ShapedLine values
Every GPUI redraw emits cached background and glyph paint commands; clean cursor redraws do not reshape
Menlo shaping through GPUI/CoreText with bold, italic, dim, hidden, inverse, underline, undercurl, and strikethrough attributes
Wide-cell spacer handling and physical-cell run geometry
Selection and block, bar, underline, and hollow-block cursor rendering
Wall-clock cursor blink phase with zero idle animation requests when blinking and transitions are inactive
Stateful marked-text IME handler with committed-text callback and cursor bounds
Headless render-cache smoke using real RenderCache and FrameDelta values

verification.gui_launch: not run: the frozen S4 contract permits an actual app launch only when explicitly authorized
